## X-Sense Home Security v1.6.7-6

- Added an SBS50 local MQTT option. Verified local reports update existing XS0B-MR and XS01-M smoke entities and XH02-M heat alarm entities. Cloud support remains enabled, and cameras are unchanged.
- Added support for XS0AD-MN and XS0AE-iA smoke alarms, XC0M-MR CO alarms, and XCG0A-iA gas and CO alarms, including model-specific test and drill controls. XCG0A-iA also reports low-CO warnings. Mute is available only where the app's restrictions allow it.
- Added voice language and night scheduling where supported by the Wi-Fi detectors, paired night scheduling for XS0AD-MN, and SBS0A hub status, paired-device reporting, and confirmed settings. These additions do not extend local MQTT coverage.
